lines.speaker: Fox
lines.text: The road ended where no road should have ended. One moment there had been trees; the next there was a valley cupped between impossible hills, blue lights drifting above the grass like patient stars.
Usually. The House has opinions about the distinction.

lines.speaker: Fox
lines.text: I could feel where she was without looking. Not direction exactly. More like the certainty of knowing where my own hand was.
Part of it. The rest can wait until you aren't swaying.

lines.speaker: Fox
lines.text: "Mara... if I wake up tomorrow and realize I can't do this, what happens?"
Then we deal with that truth. I will not turn the bond into a cage because changing it is inconvenient.
And I owe you an apology. I knew the bond might change you. I did not know it would seize your shape that hard, that quickly. I should have said more clearly how much I did not know.

lines.speaker: Fox
lines.text: "Don't decide what I can handle for me. Tell me when you don't know. Let me choose with the uncertainty included."

lines.speaker: Fox
lines.text: The promise settles somewhere beside the new awareness of her, not comfortable exactly, but solid enough to lean on.

params.text: Explore the valley, then enter the cottage to rest.
